name: What materials are best for durability in rental property remodels?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for durability in rental property remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: When remodeling a rental property, prioritize durable, low-maintenance materials that can withstand tenant wear and tear. For flooring, consider luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or ceramic tile. In kitchens, quartz or granite countertops are resilient, and durable cabinetry with solid wood fronts holds up well. Opt for semi-gloss paint for easy cleaning, and choose sturdy, simple fixtures in bathrooms and kitchens. These choices reduce future repair and replacement costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable, low-maintenance materials like LVP or ceramic tile flooring, quartz/granite countertops, solid wood cabinets, and semi-gloss paint are ideal for rental remodels.
